name: Supplier DO and Invoice Report
query:
SELECT
    pii.purchase_order AS 'PO No.',
    DATE_FORMAT(po.transaction_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'PO Date',
    pi.name AS 'Inv No.',
    DATE_FORMAT(pi.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Inv Date',
    pi.supplier_name AS 'Supplier Name',
    pi.status AS 'Status'
FROM
    `tabPurchase Invoice` AS pi
JOIN
    `tabPurchase Invoice Item` AS pii ON pii.parent = pi.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPurchase Order` AS po ON po.name = pii.purchase_order
WHERE
    pi.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND pii.purchase_order IS NOT NULL
    AND pi.is_return = 0
GROUP BY
    pi.name, pii.purchase_order
ORDER BY
    pi.name ASC;
